energy-code-compliance.body: Nine buildings on one waterfront site, seven new and two renovations, each with its own occupancy, envelope and mechanical scope: hotel blocks, a lobby and restaurant, a fitness center and the ancillary structures behind them. Compliance was carried building by building and reconciled across the development, so no structure cleared on assumptions borrowed from its neighbor.

projects.title: Substation Control Building / Utility Control Enclosure

cooling-load-calculations.body: A control enclosure with little margin on either side: too little ventilation and hydrogen accumulates off the battery bank, too much and the room will not hold temperature. Ventilation was derived from the manufacturer-published gassing rates for the batteries actually specified and sized to the one percent hydrogen limit in IEEE 484 and the International Fire Code, with cooling loads run to ASHRAE methods. Stamped and back in five business days.

projects.title: 30-Unit Condominium Using Split System Heat Pumps

cooling-load-calculations.body: Thirty units on split-system heat pumps, which means equipment is selected per unit and a tonnage rounded up once is rounded up thirty times. Loads were run room by room with orientation, glazing and party-wall conditions carried per unit rather than averaged across the building, so corner units were not sized off an interior average.

energy-code-compliance.body: Energy code compliance for a 30-unit condominium, taken down the path the jurisdiction required rather than the one that is fastest to produce. One of more than 1,080 multifamily projects Adicot has designed over the past twelve years.
